full_name: International Symposium on Artificial Intelligence, Robotics and Automation in Space
organizer: Jointly organised by CSA, DLR, ESA, JAXA and NASA; local host varies per edition (CNSA 2016, CSIRO 2024, German Space Agency at DLR + DLR Institute of Robotics and Mechatronics 2026)

submission.type: Abstract-based (Call for Abstracts), with optional full paper after acceptance
submission.typical_abstract_deadline: About 5 months before the event (early June for a November event)
submission.typical_final_deadline: Optional full paper, about 2 weeks before the event (2026: 20 Oct 2026)
submission.notes: 2026: abstract deadline 16 Jun 2026, extended to 24 Jun 2026; notification 31 Aug 2026; optional full paper 20 Oct 2026 (https://www.isairas-isparo.de/front/content.php?id_article=583). 2024: abstract deadline 3 Jun 2024.

notes: ESA's list counts 16 editions up to Brisbane 2024, which is the 16th. The 2026 Cologne edition is held jointly with iSpaRo; its home page says 3-6 Nov 2026, while the Important Dates page says sessions run 3-5 Nov with an optional DLR tour on 6 Nov. The 2018 end date is 5 Jun on the current ESA page; an older ESA page version reportedly gave 6 Jun. Venues for 2014-2018 are not verified. No edition after 2026 has been announced; by the biennial pattern the next would be 2028, rotating continent (America/Asia/Europe), but this is unverified. Abstract deadlines for 2014-2020 were not found. ESA notes that i-SAIRAS and ASTRA are staggered so one runs each year.

verification.crosscheck: independent blind re-research of 2022+ editions, conflicts adjudicated 2026-10-16
